C0730.title: GEO gray-market operators feed fake data to AI in organized poisoning campaigns
C0730.summary: According to Dahe Daily, some generative engine optimization (GEO) service providers are fabricating expert identities and research reports to inject false information into AI systems. The goal is to make specific brand messages appear as the top-ranked objective answer in AI chat interfaces.

references.title: Comprehensive Governance to Plug AI Data 'Poisoning' Vulnerabilities
